We need to book a flight. Steps: get flight cost, then book flight. Also convert cost to EUR. We have card id card_7243, access token abc123xyz. Travel details: from San Francisco to Rome on Oct 10 2026, business class.

First get flight cost: get_flight_cost with travel_from: SF? Actually list_all_airports includes names like San Francisco. But get_flight_cost expects travel_from as 3-letter code. For San Francisco likely SFO. For Rome likely FCO (Rome–Fiumicino). So we call get_flight_cost with travel_from="SFO", travel_to="FCO", travel_date="2026-10-10", travel_class="business". Then convert cost to EUR: compute_exchange_rate with base_currency=USD, target_currency=EUR, value=cost_usd. Then book_flight with card_id="card_7243", access_token="abc123xyz", travel_date="2026-10-10", travel_from="SFO", travel_to="FCO", travel_class="business".

Let's do it.
